title: Magnitude 5 earthquake hits Los Angeles area
summary:
Fire department goes into earthquake mode and deploys teams from 106 stations to examine buildings for damage

An earthquake of preliminary magnitude 5 hit the area of Manhattan Beach,…

blocks.text: An earthquake of preliminary magnitude 5 hit the area of Manhattan Beach, California, on Saturday morning, according to the United States Geological Survey (USGS). There were no immediate reports of injuries or damage.

The Los Angeles fire department went into earthquake mode, deploying personnel from 106 neighborhood fire stations to examine infrastructure for damages. No injuries or structural damage has been reported, the department said in an alert.

The city of Manhattan Beach urged residents to be prepared for aftershocks, which can occur minutes, hours and sometimes days after an earthquake. The city said on social media there is no tsunami threat at this time.

USGS reported two aftershocks in Manhattan Beach and four other earthquakes in nearby Hermosa Beach that appeared to be part of an earthquake swarm. A swarm occurs when several earthquakes are observed in a small area.
